The results of the run are kept or discarded, and the window follows.
A worker without a controller runs the controller of the process, the global simulation.
The worker of the run. Qt deletes it when its thread has finished; null while no run exists.
True when QEGTRAIN_PLAYBACK_PROFILE was "1" when the profiler was created.
The profiler of the process, created at the first call.
True when the last run executed every stage, also if a stop arrived after its last check.
Drops the replay history of the last run. The thread rule of takeReplayCandidate applies.
The block sections of the route in route order, with their ends in km.

The route as the nodes of its path, with the stations of the scene when it is given.
An energy in MJ as kWh, with kEnergyMJToKWh.
Name of stop stationIndex for the arrival statistics; "None" for an index outside the stops.
Asks the run to stop. Returns whether a run existed.
The run of the process. Its address never changes.
An empty history that keeps at most budgetBytes bytes of accounted payload.
The budget of accounted payload, in bytes.
Emitted by run() on the thread of the run before the simulation starts.
